This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their striped [[Color|brown]] skin, bulging craniums, flat, curled [[ear]]s, and protruding ridges around their [[eye]]s.<ref name="One Year Later" /> They also had the capacity to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Chandrila-Senator.png|thumb|left|200px|Den Gane, a member of this species in the Imperial Senate]]
In [[4 BBY]], a member of this species was in attendance at the wedding ceremony of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]], being one of the earliest guests to arrive.<ref name="One Year Later" /> Two years later, [[Den Gane]], a member of this species, served as an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Senator]] of [[Roona]], delivering a broadcasted speech within the [[Imperial Senate Building]] praising the Empire following the events of the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Welcome Aurebesh">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{C|The [[Aurebesh]] text appearing on the monitor as Gane makes their speech, says "[[Senator|SEN]]. [[Den Gane|DEN GANE]] • [[Roona|ROONA]]"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Chandrila-BTS.png|thumb|right|200px|Crew preparing this species on the set of the ''Andor'' Season 2 episode ''Welcome to the Rebellion'']]
The species made their debut in the [[One Year Later|first episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="One Year Later" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
